title: '#Zombie Sagashitemasu' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of Katsuwo 's #Zombie Sagashitemasu ( #I'm Looking for Zombie ) manga unveiled additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured right), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 3 at 11:30 p.m. on TV Asahi's IMAnimation programming block, followed by BS Asahi and AT-X.

Cast: Mikazuki: Youko Hikasa ( High School DxD ) Touka: Makoto Koichi ( Tensei shitara Dainana Ouji Datta node, Kimama ni Majutsu wo Kiwamemasu ) Takamo: Tomoyo Takayanagi ( Uma Musume: Pretty Derby ) Saigo: Aino Shimada ( Kakkou no Iinazuke ) Aki's Father: Kousuke Toriumi ( Youjo Senki )

Staff Art Director: Masatoshi Mutou ( Tokyo Ghoul ) Color Design: Ryouta Katsuta ( Monster Musume no Oishasan ), Maki Yamamoto ( Tensei shitara Dragon no Tamago datta ) Director of Photography: Shintarou Sakai ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) 3DCG Director: Jun'ya Satou ( Kimi wo Aishita Hitori no Boku e ) Editor: Yumiko Nakaba ( Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san ) Sound Director: Yayoi Tateishi ( Domestic na Kanojo )

Singer-songwriter Threee ( Dark Gathering ) is performing the opening theme "Lucky Lucky." J-Pop band cadode ( Summertime Render ) is performing the ending theme "Soft Apocalypse." Both theme songs are previewed in the first promotional video below.

Shinya Une ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu 3rd Season ) is directing the anime at Studio Comet , with Kyouhei Suzuki ( JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 5: Ougon no Kaze episode director) serving as assistant director. Kenichi Yamashita ( Kawaikereba Hentai demo Suki ni Natte Kuremasu ka? ) and Aki Itami ( Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san 2 ) are handling the series composition and script. Narumi Shimoji ( Rinshi!! Ekoda-chan ) is designing the characters. Kenta Higashiooji ( Princess Connect! Re:Dive ) is composing the music.

Katsuwo ( Hitoribocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu ) serialized the adventure supernatural manga in Comic Dengeki Daioh "g" from June 2022 to November 2023. Kadokawa published the third and final volume in January 2024.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English on July 27.

PV 1

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Seventh Ending Featuring "Ameato" by W-inds
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its sixth ending, featuring the song “Ameato” by W-inds. The song was used in Episodes 77-89, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the sixth ending, featuring the song “STAND UP!” performed by Lead . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: #I'm Looking For Zombie Anime's Main Trailer Reveals More Cast & Staff Members, Theme Songs, October 3 Debut
content:
Kadokawa revealed on Sunday the main promotional video, main visual, additional cast and staff members, theme song artists, and October 3 debut for the television anime of Katsuwo 's #I'm Looking For Zombie ( #Zombie Sagashitemasu ) manga. The video reveals and previews the opening theme song "Raki Raki" by Surii , and the ending theme song "Soft Apocalypse" by the band cadode .

The newly announced cast members are:

Yōko Hikasa as Mikazuki, a woman who went to the "outside world" before Aki. She visited Aki and her friends' base in search of a separated companion.

Makoto Koichi as Tōka, a female auto mechanic, rarely found in the "outside world," whom Haru saves while being attacked by zombies.

Tomoyo Takayanagi as Takamo, the sharp-tongued commander in charge of the Ueno Base.

Aino Shimada as Saigo, Takamo's 12-year-old younger brother.

Kōsuke Toriumi will voice Aki's father, who made a certain promise before leaving young Aki behind. His whereabouts and whether he is dead or alive is still unknown.

Additional staff members include:

• Art Director: Masatoshi Muto

• Color Design: Ryōta Katsuta, Maki Yamamoto

• Compositing Director of Photography: Shintarō Sakai

• 3DCG Director: Junya Sato

• Editing: Yumiko Nakaba

• Sound Director: Yayoi Tateishi

The anime will premiere on October 3 in the IMAnimation programming block of TV Asahi and 23 of its affiliated channels, and will run on Saturdays at 11:30 p.m. JST (10:30 a.m. EDT). The anime will air on BS Asahi on October 3 at 1:00 a.m. JST (effectively October 4), then on AT-X on October 5. The anime will also stream on the ABEMA and d Anime Store streaming services in Japan on October 3 at 12 midnight JST (effectively October 4).

The anime will star:

• Miyari Nemoto as Aki

• Lynn as Natsuki

• Toshiya Miyata as Haru

• Hibiku Yamamura as Yū

• Yuka Nukui as Sakura

Shin'ya Une ( Rent-A-Girlfriend season 3 director, Teasing Master Takagi-san , D.Gray-man Hallow episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Comet , and Kyōhei Suzuki ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind , Kiss Him, Not Me assistant episode director) is the assistant director. Kenichi Yamashita ( Actually, I Am… … , The Holy Grail of Eris ) and Aki Itami ( Forest of Piano , The Comic Artist and His Assistants ) are in charge of the series scripts, and Narumi Shimoji ( Charanpo Land no Bōken film, Ugoku! Neko Mukashi Banashi ) is designing the characters. Kenta Higashiohji ( Pole Princess!! , Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire ) is composing the music.

Katsuwo launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Comic Dengeki DaiohG magazine in June 2022. Kadokawa published the third and final volume in January 2024.

Yen Press announced in July it will release the manga in a complete omnibus format under the title #ImLookingForZombies .

Katsuwo 's Mitsuboshi Colors manga inspired the television anime of the same name, which premiered in January 2018. Sentai Filmworks streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Katsuwo launched the Hitori Bocchi no Marumaru Seikatsu (Solitary "__" Life, or Hitori Bocchi's "__" Life) manga in the inaugural issue of Comic Dengeki DaiohG in September 2013, and ended it in April 2021. Kadokawa published the manga's eighth and final volume in June 2021. The manga inspired a television anime adaptation in April 2019. Crunchyroll streamed the anime.
author: ANN

title: Overgeared Anime Reveals Third Trailer and Key Visual, Adds Yuki Murata and Yurika Hirayama to Cast
content:
Overgeared anime revealed its third trailer and third key visual ahead of its October 2, 2026 premiere date. Two additional cast members were also announced, while the trailer previews the ending theme “Ray of Emotion.” The second PV and visual were revealed in July during Anime Expo.

The newly announced cast members are:

• Yuki Murata as Irene

• Yurika Hirayama as Isabel

The new trailer also previews the theme songs. The opening theme song is “SATISFY” by Re:name, while the ending theme “Ray of Emotion” is performed by virtual singer and rapper TAO. You can watch the new trailer below.

Based on the popular Korean web novel by Saenal and the webtoon adaptation by Monohumbug (REDICE STUDIO) and Team Argo, Overgeared follows Youngwoo Shin, a struggling gamer whose life changes after he gets a legendary blacksmith’s inheritance inside the virtual reality MMORPG Satisfy . You can see the new key visual below.

Ayako Kono ( Sword Art Online Progressive ) is directing the anime at J.C.STAFF, with Kenta Ihara ( Sentenced to Be a Hero ) handling series composition, Ryosuke Tanigawa designing the characters, Yoshiaki Fujisawa composing the music, and Yoshikazu Iwanami serving as the sound director.

Originally serialized as a web novel before becoming one of REDICE STUDIO’s most successful webtoon adaptations, Overgeared joins a growing lineup of Korean fantasy series receiving anime adaptations following Solo Leveling , Tower of God , and The Beginning After the End .
author: Anime Corner

title: Overgeared Anime Reveals 3rd Trailer, 2 New Cast Members
content:
The official website for Tempal: Item no Chikara (Tempal ~The Power of Items~), the television anime of South Korean webtoon studio REDICE STUDIO 's Overgeared webtoon, started streaming the anime's third trailer, and revealed the third key visual, and two more cast members, on Sunday. The video previews rock band Re:name 's opening theme song "SATISFY" and the ending theme song "Ray of Emotion" by virtual singer TAO .

The newly announced cast members are:

Yūki Murata as Irene

Yurika Hirayama as Isabel

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX and BS11 channels on October 2 at 11:30 p.m. (10:30 a.m. EDT). Crunchyroll will stream the anime. Crunchyroll will also screen the anime as part of its " Crunchyroll Anime Nights" program dedicated to screening anime across the U.S. on September 21. Overgeared and other titles will screen with Japanese audio and English subtitles in theaters in the U.S. and Canada.

The anime stars:

• Tatsumaru Tachibana as Grid

• Asami Seto as Yura

• Saya Fukuzumi as Euphemina

• Shuntaro Takayama as Huroi

• Riho Sugiyama as Jishuka

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Toban

• Kō Bonkobara as Regas

• Masaya Fukunishi as Vantner

• Kōhei Amasaki as Pon (Fon)

• Shunichi Toki as Faker

Yen Press publishes the webtoon in English under its Ize Press label. Yen Press describes the story:

Youngwoo Shin is a deadbeat in real life, working odd jobs to barely pay off his loans. Even his family has written him off as a hopeless video game addict. But when he logs in to the massively popular VR game Satisfy, Youngwoo becomes Grid the Warrior…who is also painfully mediocre. Everything changes when he stumbles across a tome containing the lost knowledge of a legendary blacksmith. The catch is, using it resets all his levels! In order to survive after being forced back to square one, Grid will need to hone his skills and gather reliable allies…or not! Who needs all that when you're decked out in god-tier items?!

Ayako Kōno ( Sword Art Online the Movie -Progressive- Aria of a Starless Night , Sword Art Online The Movie - Progressive: Scherzo of Deep Night ) is directing the film at J.C. Staff , with EGG FIRM producing the anime. Kenta Ihara ( Saga of Tanya the Evil , Uncle From Another World , Blue Miburo ) is in charge of the series scripts, and Kenta Ihara ( Demon Lord 2099 , I Want to End This Love Game ) is designing the characters. Yoshikazu Iwanami is the sound director, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa is composing the music. Pony Canyon is credited for music production.

Other staff members include:

• Art Director: Yūki Kobayashi

• Color Key Artist: Miki Itō

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yuusuke Sakamoto

The webtoon is based on a web novel by Sae Nal Park . Dong Wook Lee is writing the webtoon, and Team Argo is drawing the art.

Yen Press released the 11th volume of the webtoon on August 18. The webtoon is also available digitally on Tapas . Both Tapas and WuxiaWorld are releasing the original web novel series in English.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game Adds DLC Character Kim Kaphwan on September 24
content:
SNK revealed in a new trailer on Saturday for the Fatal Fury City of the Wolves fighting game that DLC character Kim Kaphwan will launch on September 24. June Yoon voices the character in English and Kunihiro Kawamoto voices the character in Japanese.

English Trailer

Japanese Trailer

Season 3 launched on July 23 with six characters joining the roster in the next five months. Rick Strowd joined the game on July 23. Duck King launched on August 27. The game will add Laocorn in November, as well as a mystery character in December. SNK teased new characters in an animated trailer in July.

Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for the game's Season Pass 2, launched on January 22. Nightmare Geese launched on February 26, and Blue Mary debuted on March 26. Wolfgang Krauser debuted in the game on April 24, coinciding with the game's first anniversary. DLC character Mr. Karate launched on May 27. Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star debuted in the game on June 28.

The game debuted in April 2025 for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store.

The game's crossover with Street Fighter includes characters Ken and Chun-Li. Both characters are a part of the game's Season Pass 1. The game launched Andy Bogard as a playable character in June 2025, added Ken as a playable character in August 2025, introduced Joe Higashi as a playable character in October 2025, debuted Chun-Li in November 2025, and launched MR. BIG in December 2025.

The game added real-life DJ Salvatore Ganacci, professional soccer player Cristiano Ronaldo, and Hokutomaru. Other returning characters include Terry Bogard, Rock Howard, Tizoc, Hotaru Futaba, Marco Rodrigues, B. Jenet, Kevin Rian, Billy Kane, Mai Shiranui, Kim Dong Hwan, and Gato. The game also includes the new characters Preecha and Vox Reaper.

SNK announced the new game at the EVO fighting game tournament in 2022. It is the first new game in more than two decades since the last installment.

Fatal Fury (known as Garō Densetsu in Japan) is one of SNK 's most iconic fighting game franchises, and is the origin of some of the company's most recognizable characters, including Terry Bogard, Andy Bogard, Mai Shiranui, Blue Mary, Geese Howard, and more. Fatal Fury: King of Fighters debuted in arcades in 1991, and the latest installment, Garou: Mark of the Wolves , debuted in 1999. SNK 's separate fighting game franchise The King of Fighters initially began as a crossover fighter for SNK 's Fatal Fury and Art of Fighting franchises, and their characters have been mainstays in the long-running series until today.

The series inspired the Fatal Fury: Legend of the Hungry Wolf OVA in 1992, Fatal Fury 2: The New Battle OVA in 1993, and Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture in 1994. All three feature Masami Ōbari 's character designs, with Ōbari also directing the third anime. Discotek Media has released all three anime.
author: ANN

title: Actor, Narrator Leo Morimoto Dies at 83
content:
Fuji News Network and Oricon News reported on Friday that actor and narrator Leo Morimoto (birth name Haruyuki Morimoto) died suddenly from unknown causes on September 4, according to his agency. He was 83.

Morimoto was born in Nagoya city in Aichi prefecture on February 13, 1943. After graduating from the Nihon University College of Art , he worked as a DJ for a radio station. He appeared in the 1974 live-action NHK series Kiiroi Namida (Yellow-Colored Tears). He also appeared in a supporting role in a large number of TV series such as Long Vacation and Shomuni .

He narrated many commercials and documentaries, having narrated the Thomas & Friends show in Japanese for many years. He worked on 1982 puppet show Records of the Three Kingdoms as the voice of Zhuge Liang. In recent years he was known for his appearances on the Quiz Presen Variety Q-sama!! quiz variety program.

In anime, Morimoto starred as Shitotsugh Lhadatt in the Royal Space Force: The Wings of Honnêamise film. He also narrated the Bartender and Dragon Goes House-Hunting anime. He additionally voiced and Captain Erskine in Agatha Christie no Meitantei Poirot to Marple .

Morimoto also narrated the 2007 game Eternal Sonata .

title: 'Tempal: Item no Chikara' Unveils Additional Cast, Third Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Saenal Park and Team Argo 's Tempal: Item no Chikara ( Overgeared ) webtoon unveiled a pair of additional cast, third key visual (pictured), and third promotional video on Saturday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 2 at 11:30 p.m. on Tokyo MX and BS11.

Voice actresses Yuki Murata and Yurika Hirayama ( Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!? ) are joining the cast as Irene and Isabel, respectively.

Ayako Kouno ( Sword Art Online: Progressive Movie ) is directing the anime at J.C.Staff , with Kenta Ihara ( Yuusha-kei ni Shosu ) handling the series composition. Ryousuke Tanigawa ( Maou 2099 ) is designing the characters. Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( Mushoku Tensei ) is composing the music.

Park originally wrote the action fantasy series as a web novel on Munpia from June to July in 2013 before halting for an official publication. The novel officially began serialization on Munpia in November 2014 and concluded in April 2024. Maru & Maya began publishing the novel with illustrations by HABAN in January 2014 and released the 96th and final volume in December 2024.

Team Argo began drawing the webtoon adaptation on KakaoPage in April 2020.

Wuxiaworld and Tapas Media published the web novel digitally in English from October 2017 and September 2021, respectively. Tapas Media also began publishing the webtoon digitally in September 2021. Yen Press licensed the webtoon in English under its Ize Press imprint for physical release in April 2023. The seventh volume of the web novel went on sale on June 5. The 11th webtoon volume went on sale on August 18, and the 12th volume is scheduled for release on November 17.

title: Kei Urana's Gachiakuta Manga Continues Hiatus
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine commented on September 8 on the ongoing hiatus of Kei Urana 's Gachiakuta manga. Kodansha stated it will announce the manga's return once it is decided.

The magazine last published a new chapter for Gachiakuta in this year's 36th and 37th combined issue that shipped on August 5. The magazine's website for all issues since then has stated the manga was on hiatus so that Urana could conduct research.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Rudo lives in the slums of a floating town, where the poor scrape by under the shadow of the rich who live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. Then one day, he's falsely accused of murder, and his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and if Rudo wants to have any hope of discovering the truth and seeking vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, he will have to master a new power and join a group known as the Cleaners who battle the hulking trash beasts of the Pit!

Urana launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in February 2022. Hideyoshi Ando is credited for graffiti design. Kodansha published the manga's 19th compiled book volume on July 16.

The manga's television anime adaptation premiered in Japan in July 2025 on CBC , TBS , and 26 other channels. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in the following territories: North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS (excluding Russia and Belarus), and the Indian subcontinent. Crunchyroll is also streaming an English dub for the series.

The anime will get a second season.

title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power Manga Ends in Next Volume
content:
Manga artist Yona Etou announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Friday The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power: Disgraced No Longer, I'm Finding Happiness with the Prince! ( Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyō mo Muishiki ni Chikara o Tarenagasu: Kōshaku-ke no Ochikobore Reijō, Tōgisaki de Shiawase o Tsukamitoru! ) manga adaptation of Almond 's light novels will end in the next volume.

J-Novel Club publishes the light novel series and Yona Etou 's manga adaptation in English, and it describes the story:

Lady Carolina, the overlooked daughter of a powerful duke, has always believed herself to be the black sheep amid her illustrious kin. Her father is the distinguished prime minister; her elder sister, a prodigious mage destined to become their nation's next Saint. In comparison, Carolina resigns herself to a quiet existence in their shadows until a sudden and unexpected royal decree alters her destiny, thrusting her into a political marriage with the formidable “Bloodthirsty Prince” of the neighboring Empire of Malcosias.

Almond originally released the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Be Novelists) website, but removed the story from the website in May 2022. Earth Star Entertainment began publishing the series in print with Yoshiro Ambe 's illustrations in June 2021, and released the fourth and final volume in June 2023. J-Novel Club has released the entire novel series in English.

Etou's manga adaptation launched on the Comic Earth Star website in April 2022. Earth Star Entertainment released the ninth volume on September 11. J-Novel Club released the seventh compiled volume in English on August 12 digitally.

A television anime adaptation of the novels debuted on the AT-X channel on June 30 and also airs in Japan on Tokyo MX , BS11 , Tochigi TV , and Gunma TV . Crunchyroll is streaming the series as it airs.
